scope: Frozen source-bound development and heldout configurations; no GPU execution. Counts are configurations, not distinct application bug sites. Synthetic tails are separate backend stressors.

identity.trust: Build source/binary association is caller-attested. Recomputed summaries are consistency checks using the original helper, not an independent arithmetic audit.

protocol.max_rss_population: maximum over first process plus 31 repeated processes; median/p95 timing excludes first
protocol.statistical_ratios: Only successful baseline-qualified pairs. Candidate failures remain failed qualifiers; new coverage has no baseline ratio.
protocol.witness_counts: printed_write_write_witnesses counts exact typed matches in bound stdout; CLI rendering may cap them. It is not a total conflict or bug count.
protocol.safe_export_policy: Every timed safe export has complete unique coordinates and exact expression/reference hashes. Remove only validated exact duplicates; retain all logs/digests and unmatched artifacts.
